usedFor: Asana tracks the work and Google Drive holds the files. When “New Tag Created” fires in Asana, “Copy a File” can duplicate a template into a folder, so each new tag starts with its own document.

bestTemplate.name: “New Tag Created” in Asana, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new tag usually marks a new client or topic, and “Copy a File” makes a copy of a Drive file into a selected folder with a new name, so the work starts from a ready template.

watchOut: Asana triggers here, such as “New Tag Created”, are polling. They check on a schedule, so the copy can appear a little after the tag does.
